items.title: IFA 2026 Wrap-Up: Mindful Tech on the Global Stage
items.description: Amid AI-powered everything and technology designed to demand attention, Mudita brought a quieter vision to IFA Berlin 2026. Discover why visitors saw mindful tech as a refreshing and much-needed alternative.

items.title: MuditaOS K 2.0 at IFA 2026: A First Look at What’s Coming
items.description: First previewed at IFA Berlin 2026, MuditaOS K 2.0 brings InkApps, new launcher options, Google Calendar sync, customizable Offline+ Mode, and more. Discover how the update makes Mudita Kompakt more personal while keeping digital minimalism on your terms.
items.imageAlt: First look at MuditaOS K update 2-0

items.title: It’s Time for Back to School & Back to Better Habits
items.description: Summer may be winding down, but its calmer rhythm doesn't have to. Discover how intentional technology and better sleep habits can ease the return to school, work, and everyday routines.
items.imageAlt: Back to School and good habits

items.title: MuditaOS K 1.6 Brings Many New Improvements for Kompakt
items.description: Discover how MuditaOS K 1.6 makes Mudita Kompakt more capable with 38 keyboard languages, improved Maps, voicemail support, task lists, flexible vibration controls, and important security and stability updates.

items.title: Mudita Oasis Pre-Orders Extended Through August 31st
items.description: Mudita Oasis pre-orders extended until by August 31st. Orders placed during the extended pre-order period will ship by September 7th

items.title: Mudita Oasis Orders Shipped & Pre-Orders Extended Until July 31st
items.description: The first Mudita Oasis orders have already shipped! We're extending pre-orders through July 31, giving you more time to secure introductory pricing before regular sales begin.
